The proof handles t=0, all t>=0 and t->infinity, and checks normalization, derivative 15 and all terminal matching counts.

value.rationale: The unique (3,5)-cage is a canonical finite-girth benchmark for irreversible hard-dimer kinetics. While six perfect matchings are structurally possible, irreversible greedy deposition reaches one with probability 4/15 and exhibits three distinct jamming populations; the exact seven relaxation rates, full-time curve and labeled matching weights supply physically motivated finite-size transport/packing benchmarks, beyond a static counting exercise. The claim is finite and does not assert a thermodynamic limit.
